See [[franciscus-defranceschi-tailor-of-kastelir-1818-1892]]. *(doc for the death and the age; the birth year is arithmetic.)* **Film 005497821** (*Liber Defunctorum*, Parochia SS. Cosmae et Damiani, **Castellier — Kaštelir**), read on the plate 22 September 2026. **One of David's own citations, never opened here until now.**

rows.name: Catharina Defranceschi (widow of Bakar, d. 1819)
rows.note:
**«Vidua Catharina Defranceschi», died 7 April 1819 at house 121 of Buccari, aged eighty-five**, *causa senectutis*, with all the sacraments, buried in the cemetery. **Born about 1734.**

**She is the earliest-born person of the name this archive can place at Bakar**, and she was a widow — so there was a Defranceschi husband there before 1819 whom nothing here yet names. *(doc for the death, the age and the house; the birth year is arithmetic.)* **Film 005494714** (*Liber Defunctorum, Ecclesia Buccarana* — **Bakar**), read on the plate 22 September 2026. **One of David's own citations, never opened here until now.**

rows.name: Mattio Defranceschi (carpenter of Poreč, fl. 1844–1846)
rows.note:
**A *falegname* — a carpenter — at Parenzo, married to Domenica Frezza.** Named on two baptisms in the town's register:

· **Anna Maria**, born 20 October, baptised 11 November **1844**.
· **«Parenzo li 28 Luglio 1846. Paolo Francesco Domenico figlio delli giugali **Mattio Defranceschi falegn.** e **Domenica Frezza** nacque li 26 corr.»** — baptised by Canon **Pietro Monfalcon**, godparents **Francesco Marchese de Polesini** and **Ellena de Filippini-Coletti**, midwife Elena Weber.

**The godfather is the point.** The **Polesini** were the first noble house of Parenzo, and a marquis of that family stood for a carpenter's son. *(doc for both baptisms; the birth estimate is* inf*.)* **Film 005497830** (*Liber Baptizatorum*, **Parenzo — Poreč**), read on the plate 22 September 2026. **One of David's own citations, never opened here until now.**

rows.name: Paolo Francesco Domenico Defranceschi (Poreč, 1846)
rows.note: **Born 26 July 1846 at Parenzo and baptised on the 28th**, son of **Mattio Defranceschi**, carpenter, and **Domenica Frezza**. Baptised by Canon **Pietro Monfalcon**; godparents **Francesco Marchese de Polesini** and **Ellena de Filippini-Coletti**; the midwife was **Elena Weber**. *(doc.)* **Film 005497830** (*Liber Baptizatorum*, **Parenzo — Poreč**), read on the plate 22 September 2026. **One of David's own citations, never opened here until now.**

rows.name: Anna Maria Defranceschi (Poreč, 1844–1879)
rows.note:
**Born 20 October 1844 at Parenzo, baptised 11 November**, daughter of **Mattio Defranceschi**, carpenter, and **Domenica Frezza** (film 005497830).

**And almost certainly the woman who dies thirty-five years later in the same town.** *«17 Settembre 1879, casa 346 — **Anna Maria Defranceschi, moglie di Giacomo Rocco fu Matteo**»*, aged **35**, of *idrope*, all sacraments (film 005497834). **A woman born 20 October 1844 is thirty-four years and eleven months old on 17 September 1879**, which is what a clerk writes as thirty-five.

*(doc for each record separately; **inf** for joining them, on the name, the town, the arithmetic and the fact that both films are Parenzo's. The death entry's «fu Matteo» reads most naturally as her husband's father — but her own father was a Matteo too, and the archive notes that rather than choosing.)* **Film 005497830** (*Liber Baptizatorum*, **Parenzo — Poreč**), read on the plate 22 September 2026. **One of David's own citations, never opened here until now.**

rows.name: Euphemia di Batta Defranceschi (1739)
rows.note:
«**Die 4 8bris 1739** … baptizavit unam infantulam **natam die 1ma currentis a Batta Defranceschi et Jacoba ejus legitima uxore ambobus ex hac Parochia**, cui positum fuit nomen **Euphemia**» — **born 1 October, baptised 4 October 1739**. Godparents **D.nus Aloysius Spinotti** and **Ursula, wife of Francesco Marzoni**.

***Batta* is Battista**, so her father is a **Giovanni Battista Defranceschi** — and the same register has one standing godfather five months earlier, on 19 April 1739. *This is very probably [[joannes-baptista-de-franceschi-of-svetvincenat-fl-1739]]'s household.* **(inf for the identification; doc for the baptism.)**

**And she raises a question the archive cannot answer.** Fourteen months before her, on **27 July 1738**, *«**Petro** de Franceschi et **Jacoba** ejus legitima uxore»* baptise a daughter **Anna Euphemia**. **Same mother's name, same daughter's name, two different fathers' forenames.** **And the balance has since shifted against *Batta*.** On **29 December 1739**, eleven weeks after this baptism, the same register enters a godmother as ***«Jacoba uxor **Petri** Defranceschi»*** — and *Jacoba* was already **Pietro's** wife in July 1738. **So the register names Jacoba as Pietro's wife twice, on either side of the one entry that gives her to a Batta.**

*The likeliest reading is now that this child belongs to **Pietro and Jacoba** and that the clerk wrote the wrong husband here — which would make her the second Euphemia of that household, the first having died.* **The entry still reads *Batta* under magnification and has not been altered**; what has changed is which way the evidence leans. *(The identification with [[joannes-baptista-de-franceschi-of-svetvincenat-fl-1739]] is accordingly withdrawn to* lore*.)*

**Film 005497885, image 123** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 22 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

rows.name: Helena di Matteo Defranceschi (1742)
rows.note:
«**Die 10 Augusti 1742** … baptizavit unam infantulam, **natam die 5 currentis a Matthæo Defranceschi, et Francisca ejus legitima uxore ambobus ex hac Parochia**, cui positum fuit nomen **Helena**» — **born 5 August, baptised 10 August 1742**, godparent **Martinus Stancovich**.

**She is ten years older than her sister.** The same couple baptise **Irena** in February 1752, and **Francisca is already named as Matteo's wife in August 1741**. *So this household stands at the castle across at least eleven years, and both its known children were born inside the stretch no index covers.* *(doc.)* **Film 005497885, images 129–131** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

rows.name: Casparus Defranceschi (of Svetvinčenat, fl. 1741)
rows.note:
**Godfather on 17 August 1741** — *«Patrini fuerunt **Casparus Defranceschi**, et Cattarina uxor Pauli Vannich»*.

**A man of this name is already on the roster**, a *Gasparo De Franceschi* born **1718** off the index, who would be **twenty-three** in 1741 — the right age to be asked. *(inf for the identification; doc for the appearance.)* **Film 005497885, images 129–131** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

rows.name: Joanna Defranceschi (of Svetvinčenat, fl. 1741)
rows.note:
**Godmother on 30 June 1741** — *«Patrini vero fuerunt Jacobus Zanco, et **Joanna Defranceschi**»*.

**She is entered under the surname in her own right**, not as somebody's wife, which in this register usually means an unmarried daughter of the house. *Which house is not said.* *(doc for the appearance; nothing else places her.)* **Film 005497885, images 129–131** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

rows.name: Joannes Baptista de Franceschi «ex Cargna» (1742)
rows.note:
**«Die 20 Xbris 1742** … baptizavi unam infantulam **spuriam**, natam heri, a **Gregorio Bercar** et **Maria Simebich ex Parochia Barbana**, cui positum fuit nomen **Victoria**. **Patrini fuerunt Joannes Baptista de Franceschi, ex Cargn.**, et **Maria uxor Gasparis Perlar**.»

**He is the only person of this name in the whole register who is given an origin.** Everyone else is *«ambo ex hac Parochia»* or nothing at all — the clerk marks him because he is **not** of the parish.

***Cargna* is the Venetian and Italian form of *Carnia*.** The word is abbreviated with a suspension stroke and is given here as read. *(The expansion is* inf*; the letters* C-a-r-g-n *are* doc*.)*

**Why this matters more than another godparent line.** *«Ex Carnia»* is the exact phrase the Fiume marriage register attaches to **Valentino de Franceschi** on **28 February 1737** — and **Joannes Baptista** is the forename at the centre of [the Fiume question](/worklist/), where a man of that name and unknown origin fathers a child at Fiume in **1748**.

**This is not that man, and is not claimed to be.** It is the first document this archive has found that puts **the right surname, the right forename and a Carnian origin together inside Istria in the right decade**. *(lore for any connection to Fiume; doc for the entry.)*

**And it unsettles the two Joannes Baptistas already here.** One was dead by October 1737; one stood godfather in April 1739. *Whether the 1739 man and this one are the same — and therefore whether the Svetvinčenat Battistas are themselves Carnian incomers — the register does not say.*

**Film 005497885, image 132** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026 and magnified three times. **In no index anywhere.**

**A third time, and the fullest spelling yet: «ex Cargno».** **14 September 1744**, at the baptism of Michael son of Mari Milovar: *«Patrini ad Sacrum fontem fuerunt **Joannes Baptis-/:ta Defranceschi ex Cargno**, et Catharina Uxor Bene Mesciarovich»* — the surname broken across the line, the origin whole. Magnified. **Film 005497885, image 138**, read 23 September 2026. *(doc.)*

**A fourth time, ten months later.** **1 June 1745**, at the baptism of Vitus son of Gregorio Barbar: *«Patrini fuere, **Joannes Baptis-/:ta Defranceschi ex Cargno**, et Cata uxor Caspari Venier»*. Magnified. **This entry is on the page the loose slip covers on image 140** and is legible only on **image 141**. *(doc.)* **Four statements of Carnia across four years — 1742, 1743, 1744, 1745 — and he is the only man of the name the register ever places.**

rows.name: Casparus di Jacobo Defranceschi (1743)
rows.note:
«**Casparus filius legitimus Jacobi Defranceschi, et Francisca ejus legitimæ uxoris, amborum ex hac Parochia** … baptizatus fuit a R.do D.no **Martino Zolonta Capellano**. Patrini fuerunt D.nus **Dominicus Xaverii Bosponi**, et D.na **Catharina filia Dominici Louicini ex Dignano**. **Natus die 1mo currentis.**» — **born 1 June, baptised 15 June 1743**.

**He was published here as «the child who sorts out his own father». He is not.** His mother **Francisca** overlaps **Pascasia**, whose four children by a Giacomo run **1750–1759** ([h107]), so his father cannot be identified with the Jacobo of the 1737 twins on the strength of this act. *His own baptism is unaffected — both parents are named in full and «of this parish».* **(doc for the act; the father is one of at least two Giacomos.)** See [[jacobo-de-franceschi-of-svetvincenat-fl-1737-1752]] and [/corrections/](/corrections/). **Film 005497885, image 134** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

rows.name: Vittorio Defranceschi (godfather 1744)
rows.note:
**5 June 1744, at the baptism of a foundling.** *«Petrus filius natus a parentibus ignotis, baptizatus fuit a me infrascripto. **Patrini ad Sacrum fontem fuerunt, Victorij Defranceschi**, et Euphemia vidua Georgi Bratolich.»* Magnified and read letter by letter.

**This is not the Vittorio this archive already carries.** [[vittorio-de-franceschi-son-of-antonio]] was born about **1758** and first witnesses in **1773**. *A man standing godfather in 1744 was an adult then* — born about 1723 at the very latest, and more likely around 1715. **They are two men, fourteen years and a generation apart, and the name repeats because Istrian households repeated names.** *(doc for the appearance; the birth window is inferred from the office he is holding.)*

**He is very probably the grandfather the later Vittorio is named for.** The castle's line of the name runs **Antonio → Vittorio → Antonio** on this archive's existing evidence; a Vittorio active in 1744 sits exactly where a grandfather would. *(inf, and no more than that — no entry joins them.)*

**Film 005497885, image 137** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

**He has a household, and it is on the page behind the slip.** **13 June 1745**: *«**Antonia filia Victorij Defranceschi, et Dominica ejus legitima Uxoris amborum ex hac Parochia**, nata die 12 currentis»* — **[[antonia-di-vittorio-defranceschi-1745]]**. **His wife is Dominica**, and both of them are «of this parish», so neither is an incomer. *(doc.)* **This is what separates him from the later Vittorio beyond doubt**: a man with a baptised child in 1745 is not a man born about 1758. **Film 005497885, image 141.**

rows.name: Gasparo Defranceschi (husband of Maria, fl. 1744)
rows.note:
**5 May 1744: *«patrini fuerunt Dominicus del Corvo … et **Maria uxor Caspari Defranceschi**»*.** Magnified and read letter by letter.

**He settles a question this archive had left open between two wrong candidates.** [[gasparo-de-franceschi]]'s dossier weighs the **30 March 1773** marriage entry *«Joannes Volge, et **Maria relicta q.m Gasparis de Franceschi**»* — a widow of a Gasparo remarrying — against two men: the twin baptised **1737** and the **Domenico Gasparo** baptised **1732**.

**Neither of them can be the husband.** *A man whose wife is named in a godparent line in May 1744 was married by 1744.* The twin was **six**; Domenico Gasparo was **eleven**. **The archive was choosing between two boys.**

**The wife's name matches, twenty-nine years apart.** *Maria* is Caspar Defranceschi's wife in **1744** and *Maria* is the widow of the late Gaspar de Franceschi in **1773**. **One couple, one lifetime, and the 1773 entry is his death notice in all but name.** *(doc for both entries; the identification of the two Marias as one woman is **inf**, on the forename, the surname of the husband, the single parish and the ordinary span of a marriage.)*

**So the castle held a third Gasparo**, older than both the boys — born about 1715, married by 1744, dead by March 1773.

**Film 005497885, image 137** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

**A second attestation seven months later.** **29 November 1744**, at the baptism of Joanna Magdalena, daughter of D.nus Jacobus Zuecht: *«Patrini fuere, D.nus Marius Zocchi **Chirurgus**, et **Maria Uxor Caspari Defranceschi**»*. Magnified. **His wife stands beside the parish surgeon**, which says something about the household's standing. *(doc.)* **Film 005497885, image 139.**

**And a third attestation, which is now the earliest.** **15 February 1744**: *«Patrini fuere D.us **Jacobus Zuecha**, et **Maria uxor Caspari Defranceschi**»* — magnified. **Maria is named as his wife three times in 1744 alone**, in February, May and November, each time in the same formula and never with a different husband. *That steadiness is the whole argument: she is not a clerk's slip, she is a wife.* *(doc.)* **Film 005497885, image 136.**

rows.name: Valentino di Pietro Defranceschi (1745)
rows.note:
«**Die 14 Februarij, 1745. Valentinus filius legitimus Petri Defranceschi, et Jacoba ejus legitima uxoris, ambobus ex hac Parochia**, natus die **11 currentis**, baptizatus fuit (de licentia mei infrascripti) a R.do D.no **Petro Tobis** Canc.; Patrini fuerunt, **Antonius Valentinus Colovri ex Cargno**, et **Maria filia q. Matthei Bergovi**.» — **born 11 February, baptised 14 February 1745.** Magnified and read letter by letter.

**He is named for his godfather**, which is ordinary, and his godfather is *«ex Cargno»* — **from Carnia**, which is not. *(doc.)*

**Third child of [[pietro-de-franceschi-of-svetvincenat]] and Jacoba**, after Anna Euphemia (1738) and Euphemia (1739), and the entry that carries the couple furthest forward: **seven years of one marriage, in a parish whose register hands the name Jacobo three wives in eight days.**

**Film 005497885, image 139** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

rows.name: Antonia di Vittorio Defranceschi (1745)
rows.note:
«**Die 13 Junij, 1745. Antonia filia Victorij Defranceschi, et Dominica ejus legitima Uxoris amborum ex hac Parochia, nata die 12 currentis** (de licentia mei infrascripti) baptizata fuit a R.do D.no **Antonio Stancovich** Canc.: Patrini fuerunt, Vincentius Bracovich, et **Elena vidua defuncti Blasij Marsoni**.» — **born 12 June, baptised 13 June 1745.** Magnified and read letter by letter.

**Her godmother is the widow of the man who stood for Pietro's daughter seven years earlier.** *Blasius Marsoni, smith*, was godfather to [[anna-euphemia-di-pietro-de-franceschi-1738]] on 27 July 1738; by June 1745 he is dead and **Elena** is standing in his place. *Two Defranceschi households, one family of smiths, seven years apart.* *(doc.)*

**She was hidden by a piece of paper.** Her entry is on page 125 of the volume, and on **image 140** that page is covered by a loose slip — an Italian memorandum of the castle chancellor's own child, with the Captain of the Castle as godfather. **Image 141 is the same opening photographed again with the slip lifted**, and only there does this baptism exist. *(See [the method note](/method/) on duplicate frames.)*

**Film 005497885, images 140 and 141** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

rows.name: Maria di Matteo Defranceschi (1745)
rows.note:
«**Die 28 8bris, 1745. Maria filia Matthæi Defranceschi, et Francisca ejus legitima uxoris amborum ex hac Parochia, nata die 15 currentis**, baptizata fuit (de licentia mei infrascripti) a R.do D.no **Petro Tobis** Canc. hujus Castri; Patrini fuere, **Dominicus Diasich ex Dignano**, et **Elena uxor Joanis Filipich ex Fasano**.» — **born 15 October, baptised 28 October 1745.** Magnified.

**Both godparents come from outside the parish** — Dignano and Fasana, two of the Istrian towns this archive already tracks. *(doc.)*

**Middle child of [[matteo-defranceschi-of-svetvincenat]] and Francesca**, between Helena (1742) and Irena (1752), and the entry that turns three scattered years into an eleven-year household.

**Film 005497885, images 142–143** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

rows.name: Victoria di Pietro Defranceschi (1746)
rows.note:
«**Die 10. Februarij, 1746. Victoria filia Petri Defranceschi, et Jacoba ejus legitima uxoris amborum ex hac Parochia, nata die 1mo currentis**, (de licentia mei infrascripti) baptizata fuit a R.do D.no **Petro Tobis** Canc.; Patrini ad Sanctum Fontem fuerunt, **Joannes Clozo faber**, et **Maria filia defuncti Matthei Bergovi**.» — **born 1 February, baptised 10 February 1746.** Magnified.

**Fourth child of [[pietro-de-franceschi-of-svetvincenat]] and Jacoba**, and the last so far — the household now runs **1738 to 1746**. *(doc.)*

**Her godfather is a smith, as her eldest sister's was.** *Joannes Clozo faber* here; *Blasius Marsoni faber* at Anna Euphemia's font in 1738. **Two smiths, eight years apart, for the same household.** *(inf, and only an observation.)*

**Film 005497885, images 142–143** — *Births 1709–1764* of Svetvinčenat, read on the plate 23 September 2026. **In no index anywhere.**

rows.name: Martina Antonia di Jacobo Defranceschi (1746)
rows.note:
«**Die 31. Martij, 1746. Martina Antonia filia legitima Jacobi Defranceschi, et Pascasia ejus legitima uxoris amborum ex hac Parochia, nata 28 currentis**, (de licentia mei infrascripti) baptizata fuit a R.do D.no **Petro Tobis** Canc.; Patrini fuerunt, **D.nus Martinus Peispach ex Dignano**, et **D.na Seraphina**, wife of D.nus Seraphinus.» — **born 28 March, baptised 31 March 1746.** Magnified and read letter by letter.

**She is the entry that ends the argument about her father.**

**Two women are now mothers by a Jacobo Defranceschi in full parental entries three years apart** — *«et **Francisca** ejus legitimæ uxoris»* at **[[casparus-di-jacobo-defranceschi-1743]]**'s baptism on 15 June 1743, and *«et **Pascasia** ejus legitima uxoris»* here. **Both are «ambo ex hac Parochia». Neither is a godparent line.**

**And they interleave rather than succeed one another.** *Pascasia* stands godmother as *«uxor Jacobi Defranceschi»* on **24 November 1743**; *Franca Marcario* stands godmother in the same formula **seven days later**, on 1 December 1743; and Francisca is named his wife again in **March and December 1752**, after Pascasia's children have begun. **No widower remarries and is widowed again in a week.**

**So the castle held two contemporary Jacobo de Franceschis** — one married to **Francisca Marcario**, one to **Pascasia** — and this girl is the second man's daughter. *(doc for the act; the separation of the two men is **inf**, on two series of parental and godparental attestations that overlap.)*

**She also moves her own household back four years.** [h107] had run **1750–1759** on four children. It begins in **1746**, and she is the eldest.

**Her godfather comes from Dignano and is styled *D.nus*.**

rows.note:
«**Die 20 Xbris [1743]** … Patrini fuerunt, D.us **Jacobus Zuecha**, necnon **Antonia filia q.m Joannis Baptistæ De-/:franceschi**.» — magnified and read letter by letter.

**She is named by her dead father**, which is how the register identifies an unmarried woman, so in December 1743 she is **grown and not yet married**. *That puts her birth about 1720, and no later than about 1727.* *(doc for the appearance; the birth window is inferred from the office and the wording.)*

**⚠ Her father is not the Carnic Joannes Baptista.** *«q.m»* — *quondam*, the late — but **[[joannes-baptista-de-franceschi-ex-cargna-1742]] is standing godfather at this same font in 1744 and again in 1745**, alive. **They are two men of one forename**, which by now is the ordinary condition of this parish rather than a surprise. *(inf.)*
